subject: Universal Free Breakfast Pilot Program
overview: The School Committee approved the fiscal year 2020 budget and a three-month pilot program for universal free breakfast in all schools. The body also finalized the annual evaluation of Superintendent Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent, rating her performance as proficient across all standards.

items.title: Routine Business
items.summary: Approved the June 3 minutes, various payrolls, and bills after clarifying specific grant and special fund expenditures.

items.title: Subcommittee Reports
items.summary: Accepted reports from the Special Education and Rules subcommittees, including an update to school committee rules using gender-neutral language and new policy tracking metadata.

items.title: Superintendent's Report
items.summary: Superintendent Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent reported on the administrator retreat, athletic achievements, and various student activities including a Pride flag dedication.

items.title: Recognition of Kiwanis Club
items.summary: The committee recognized the Kiwanis Club for their year-long support of literacy projects, student leadership clubs, and high school athletics.

items.title: Mass General Hospital Cannabis Study
items.summary: Approved a marijuana abstinence research study by Dr. Randy Schuster to be conducted at both the middle and high schools starting in fall 2019.

items.title: School Choice and Meeting Dates
items.summary: Voted not to participate in the state school choice program for the upcoming year and approved the school committee meeting calendar for 2019-2020.

items.title: Universal Free Breakfast Feasibility
items.summary: Approved a pilot program to provide universal free breakfast for all students during the first quarter of the school year, with a viability review scheduled for December. Members discussed the disparity in participation rates between schools using 'breakfast after the bell' versus traditional before-school service.

items.title: Superintendent's Evaluation
items.summary: Filed a rating of proficient for Superintendent Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent following her first annual performance evaluation.

items.title: FY 2020 Budget Approval
items.summary: Approved the fiscal year 2020 school department budget and associated motions regarding vocational scheduling and building rental checklists.
